_migration_note: Repointed from legacy 'Fybroc Nomenclature_V5.xlsm' to authoritative 'Nomenclature_V6.xlsm' Attributes sheet. V6 header row 7, data from row 8 for Size (J/K), Pump Material (M/N), Impeller Trim (P/Q), Motor Modifications (S/T). SERIES is special: V6 cols F/G/H hold TWO tables - a series+flange OPTION LIST at rows 7-20 (F=series, G=flange, H=blank) and the SERIES+FLANGE->CODE table at rows 22-42 (F=series, G=flange, H=code). This flat single-row_from compiler reads SERIES as F->H, so it emits harmless INCOMPLETE warnings for the code-less list rows (8-20) and DUPLICATE_DISPLAY warnings because the bare series repeats across flange variants. That is expected: the authoritative SERIES code is the composite Series+Flange, resolved at runtime by cfg.fn_LookupIdentifierCode using the '{series} ({flange})' key (see src/api/v2_routes.py). TESTING removed - V6 moved testing to a dedicated Testing sheet. See scripts/compile_fybroc_v6_attributes.py and docs/evidence/F110/FYBROC_V6_ATTRIBUTES.json.
